eyebrow.zh: 观察 ChatGPT 标签页的完成与重复消息信号，通过已配置的 IM webhook 发出提醒。
eyebrow.en: Observe completion and repeated-message signals in a ChatGPT tab and route alerts through configured IM webhooks.

headline.zh:
任务状态有变化，
让提醒来找你
headline.en:
A run changes state.
Bring the alert to you.

sub.zh: 观察 ChatGPT 标签页的完成与重复消息信号，通过已配置的 IM webhook 发出提醒。
sub.en: Observe completion and repeated-message signals in a ChatGPT tab and route alerts through configured IM webhooks.

caption.zh: 页面观察 · 类型化提醒

body.zh: 从 streaming 到 idle 且有最终消息时生成完成信号。
body.en: Emit completion when streaming becomes idle with a final message.

body.zh: 基于多轮文本重复发出可疑循环信号。
body.en: Flag suspected loops from repeated substantial messages across turns.

body.zh: 分别配置三个 IM webhook 及其启用状态。
body.en: Configure each of the three IM webhooks and enable states.

body.zh: 长任务运行时，反复打开标签页只为看看是否结束很打断工作。AgentBeacon 在浏览器侧观察状态变化，把一次完成、可疑重复和运行超时转换成可路由的事件。提醒仍需要启用的浏览器扩展和有效 webhook。
body.en: Repeatedly opening a long-running task just to check its status interrupts other work. AgentBeacon observes browser-side changes and turns a completed turn, suspicious repetition or elapsed-time threshold into a routable event. Alerts still require an enabled extension and a working webhook.

body.zh: 演示直接运行真实 Detector，输入固定的合成状态快照，分别得到 completed 和 loop_suspected。没有读取真实 ChatGPT 页面、发送 IM 或测试账户额度。
body.en: The demo runs the real Detector on fixed synthetic observations and emits completed and loop_suspected. It does not read a live ChatGPT page, send IM messages or inspect account usage.

alt.zh: 演示直接运行真实 Detector，输入固定的合成状态快照，分别得到 completed 和 loop_suspected。没有读取真实 ChatGPT 页面、发送 IM 或测试账户额度。
alt.en: The demo runs the real Detector on fixed synthetic observations and emits completed and loop_suspected. It does not read a live ChatGPT page, send IM messages or inspect account usage.

body.zh: content.ts 通过 MutationObserver 采样页面，detector.ts 的状态机产生 AgentRunSignal；background.ts 管理 chrome.alarms 与分发。频道模块构造飞书、钉钉、企业微信请求，配置保存在 chrome.storage.local。
body.en: content.ts samples the page through MutationObserver. detector.ts emits AgentRunSignal values; background.ts manages chrome.alarms and dispatch. Channel modules build Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom requests, with configuration in chrome.storage.local.

alt.zh: content.ts 通过 MutationObserver 采样页面，detector.ts 的状态机产生 AgentRunSignal；background.ts 管理 chrome.alarms 与分发。频道模块构造飞书、钉钉、企业微信请求，配置保存在 chrome.storage.local。
alt.en: content.ts samples the page through MutationObserver. detector.ts emits AgentRunSignal values; background.ts manages chrome.alarms and dispatch. Channel modules build Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom requests, with configuration in chrome.storage.local.

body.zh: 观察与分类在浏览器本地进行，通知通过用户配置的 webhook 发送。纯逻辑演示只覆盖分类器，频道送达属于另一项需要真实配置的验证。
body.en: Observation and classification run locally in the browser; notifications use user-configured webhooks. The pure-logic demo covers the classifier only. Channel delivery requires separate validation with real configuration.

alt.zh: 观察与分类在浏览器本地进行，通知通过用户配置的 webhook 发送。纯逻辑演示只覆盖分类器，频道送达属于另一项需要真实配置的验证。
alt.en: Observation and classification run locally in the browser; notifications use user-configured webhooks. The pure-logic demo covers the classifier only. Channel delivery requires separate validation with real configuration.

title.en: An alert does not stop a run

body.zh: 当前阈值触发提醒，不会阻断账户消费或点击停止按钮。
body.en: Current thresholds emit alerts; they do not block spending or press a stop button.

note.zh: 演示直接运行真实 Detector，输入固定的合成状态快照，分别得到 completed 和 loop_suspected。没有读取真实 ChatGPT 页面、发送 IM 或测试账户额度。
note.en: The demo runs the real Detector on fixed synthetic observations and emits completed and loop_suspected. It does not read a live ChatGPT page, send IM messages or inspect account usage.

body.zh: 固定一分钟的状态变化产生 completed。
body.en: A fixed one-minute transition emits completed.

body.zh: 三轮中重复长消息产生 loop_suspected。
body.en: Repeating a substantial message across three turns emits loop_suspected.

body.zh: 扩展构建需要 Node.js 22+；下面的离线 TypeScript 示例使用 Bun。构建后可在 chrome://extensions 加载 dist/，这一步由使用者手动完成。
body.en: The extension build requires Node.js 22+. The offline TypeScript demo below uses Bun. After building, load dist/ manually through chrome://extensions.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentbeacon.git
cd agentbeacon
npm ci
npm run build

bun examples/presentation_demo.ts completed
bun examples/presentation_demo.ts loop

limitations.zh: DOM 选择器依赖页面结构，未在本次离线演示中验证当前线上页面。
limitations.en: DOM selectors depend on page structure; this offline demo does not validate the current live page.

limitations.zh: 重复文本只是启发式信号，不证明服务端动作陷入循环。
limitations.en: Repeated text is a heuristic signal, not proof of a server-side action loop.

limitations.zh: 不读取实际用量，也不执行硬额度限制。
limitations.en: The extension does not read actual usage or enforce a hard quota.
